signed_rows.behavior: kmctl init writes .okf/summary.md with type: summary and the sections Decisions, Architecture, Open work, Practices and Known gaps, links it from .okf/index.md, and the bundle passes strict OKF validation; kmctl schema summary prints the kind's schema; kmctl new does not offer summary as a concept to add (there is one).
signed_rows.fails_when: the file, a section or the index link is missing, strict validation fails, or kmctl schema summary fails

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl check fails when the summary's body (outside front matter) is over 500 words, naming the count and the limit, and passes at 500 words or fewer.
signed_rows.fails_when: a 501-word body passes, a 500-word body fails, or the failure does not name the count

signed_rows.behavior: kmctl review due lists the summary with reason `concepts changed: ID, ...` when a concept (manifesto, decision, practice, proposal, prototype README, architecture page) changed in a commit after the last commit that changed the summary, or is changed (or new and untracked) in the working tree while the summary is not; never for log.md, an index, a handoff or the summary itself; a concept changed in the same commit as the summary does not count.
signed_rows.fails_when: any of these cases is listed wrongly, the reason does not name the changed concepts, or a log, index or handoff change lists it

signed_rows.behavior: An edit to .okf/summary.md, or kmctl summary ack, clears the summary from kmctl review due; ack writes checked.at (today) and checked.against (the concept ids that were listed) into its front matter and nothing else; the summary is never listed as unverified or for stale_after; kmctl check and the CI action report a stale summary without failing.
signed_rows.fails_when: the summary stays listed after an edit or ack, ack writes anything else, the summary is listed as unverified or stale_after, or kmctl check exits nonzero only because the summary is stale

signed_rows.behavior: checked (checked.at, checked.against) is a named extension field: ALLOWED_FIELDS has its keys, okf.field reads them, and the fields test covers what ack writes; .okf/manifesto.md's I4 names handoff_key and checked.
signed_rows.fails_when: okf.field raises on checked, the fields test does not cover it, or I4 still says handoff_key is the only extension
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_okf_fields.py tests/test_summary.py -k checked -q

signed_rows.behavior: The briefing says Start at .okf/summary.md, and its state line says summary current or summary behind: N concepts changed, within the 500-token budget in the long-handoff-title worst case; the AGENTS.md block kmctl init writes says the same and gives the duty to update the summary or run kmctl summary ack after adding or changing a concept.
signed_rows.fails_when: the briefing still starts at .okf/index.md, the state line lacks the summary's state, the worst case is over 500 tokens, or the block lacks the pointer or the duty
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_briefing.py tests/test_summary.py -k summary -q

signed_rows.behavior: This repository has its own .okf/summary.md of at most 500 words linking down to its concepts, and kmctl check passes on it; a decision records the summary, its limit, the freshness rule and ack, and the docs reference lists kmctl summary ack.
signed_rows.fails_when: the file is missing or over the limit, kmctl check fails, no decision names the summary, or the reference lacks the verb

signed_rows.behavior: The full suite and every tier pass.
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest -q -m "not integration or integration"
